KOM Sprint | Montée de Waldbillig (127.2 km)

story: A breakaway formed with five riders. Two Coloquick cyclists joined at 50 km to create a three-rider team lead. Soudal Quick-Step attempted to break the race on the second local lap but failed. Multiple escape attempts were neutralized, culminating in Marijn van den Berg sprinting to victory and taking the leader’s jersey.
